Modern.brandNameRationale: Anchor: the Coptic stitch — the chain-stitched binding developed by early Christian communities in Egypt from the 2nd century, the earliest codex binding still in use. '& Co.' frames the brand as a modern small studio in the trade register.
Modern.industrySummary: Modern bookbinding is a small editorial category — small studios serving artists, small presses, and conservation clients. The opening is for a stitch-named studio that publishes the technique and the materials of every binding.
Modern.competitorLandscape: Mr Cup (mr-cup.com) plays the editorial reference. The Society of Bookbinders (societyofbookbinders.com) holds the craft middle. Hewit & Sons (hewit.com) is the leather-and-supplies peer. We sit as a single-stitch modern studio.
Modern.positioningStatement: Coptic & Co. is a modern bookbinding studio specialising in Coptic-stitch bindings for small presses and artists.

targetAudience.primary: Small-press publishers and artists commissioning short-run bindings.
behaviors: Care about visible stitch and exposed spine
Pay per binding, not per page

dos: Name the stitch and the thread
donts: Photograph the binder's hands at work

Modern.logoDirection: Wordmark: COPTIC & CO. set in a confident modern grotesk, two words on one line. Small mark: a single chain-stitch silhouette used on the colophon.

typography.primary: Söhne for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: Söhne Mono for material lists and binding numbers
typography.rationale: A modern grotesk plus its mono — the colophon register.

Modern.brandDescription: Coptic & Co. is a modern bookbinding studio specialising in Coptic-stitch bindings for small presses and artists.
Modern.scope: Coptic & Co. works across the bookbinding & restoration category with a single editorial register.
Modern.mission: Coptic & Co. is a modern bookbinding studio specialising in Coptic-stitch bindings for small presses and artists.
Modern.vision: Coptic & Co. held in its register, indefinitely.

Luxury.brandNameRationale: Anchor: Roger Powell (1896-1990), the 20th-century master bookbinder whose Trinity College Dublin work re-set the standard for conservation binding. Powell is a surname, not a live marque trademark; 'Daughters' frames the brand as a family atelier across generations.
Luxury.industrySummary: Luxury bookbinding is a narrow editorial category — small family ateliers serving libraries, collectors, and conservation clients. The opening is for a family-named bindery in the conservation register.
Luxury.competitorLandscape: Shepherds Bookbinders (bookbinding.co.uk) plays the heritage London peer. Designer Bookbinders (designerbookbinders.org.uk) holds the master-craft middle. Hewit & Sons (hewit.com) is the leather-supplies reference. We belong with Shepherds in the family-atelier register.
Luxury.positioningStatement: Powell & Daughters is a heritage bindery making conservation and fine bindings for libraries and collectors, in the Roger Powell tradition.

targetAudience.primary: Library conservators, rare-book collectors, and institutional clients.
behaviors: Wait six to eighteen months on a single piece

dos: Name the conservator and the year
Treat the book as the artefact
Print the binding card with the work

Luxury.logoDirection: Wordmark: POWELL & DAUGHTERS set in a classical book serif, three lines centered. Small mark: a single tooled corner ornament used as the embossed seal.

typography.primary: Tiempos Headline for the wordmark and signage
typography.secondary: Garamond Premier Pro for body and the binding card
typography.rationale: A classical serif plus a reading serif — the conservation-bindery register.

Luxury.brandDescription: Powell & Daughters is a heritage bindery making conservation and fine bindings for libraries and collectors, in the Roger Powell tradition.
Luxury.scope: Powell & Daughters works across the bookbinding & restoration category with a single editorial register.
Luxury.mission: Powell & Daughters is a heritage bindery making conservation and fine bindings for libraries and collectors, in the Roger Powell tradition.
Luxury.vision: Powell & Daughters held in its register, indefinitely.

Minimal.brandNameRationale: Anchor: the endpaper — the printed or marbled sheet that holds the bookblock to the case, the threshold page of every bound book. One trade word, instantly legible to anyone who handles books seriously.
Minimal.industrySummary: Minimal bookbinding brands serve the design-literate small-press and stationery buyer — one binding, one stock, one label.
Minimal.competitorLandscape: Most binderies publish a long menu of finishes. The minimal end is largely empty. Mr Cup (mr-cup.com) is the closest editorial reference. We sit as the single-word minimal option.
Minimal.positioningStatement: Endpaper is a minimal bookbinder offering one binding format on one marbled endpaper stock.

targetAudience.primary: Small-press publishers and stationery buyers 28-50 who want one format done well.
behaviors: Care about the endpaper, not the cover

Minimal.logoDirection: Wordmark: ENDPAPER set very large in a clean modern sans, one word. No symbol.

typography.primary: ABC Diatype for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: ABC Diatype Mono for the binding numbers
typography.rationale: Clean Diatype with its mono — the single-format register.

Minimal.brandDescription: Endpaper is a minimal bookbinder offering one binding format on one marbled endpaper stock.
Minimal.scope: Endpaper works across the bookbinding & restoration category with a single editorial register.
Minimal.mission: Endpaper is a minimal bookbinder offering one binding format on one marbled endpaper stock.
Minimal.vision: Endpaper held in its register, indefinitely.

Corporate.brandNameRationale: Anchor: case binding — the hardcover binding format that has been the standard for archival and library books since the 19th century. 'Archives Co.' frames the brand as a B2B archival-binding operator.
Corporate.industrySummary: Archival binding is a small institutional category serving libraries, museums, government archives, and corporate records departments. The opening is for a heritage-named operator with documented archival standards.
Corporate.competitorLandscape: ICI Bookbinders (icibookbinders.com) plays the institutional peer. Houchen Bindery (houchenbindery.com) holds the library middle. HF Group (hfgroup.net) is the multi-service reference. We sit as a case-binding-led archival operator.
Corporate.positioningStatement: Case-Bound Archives Co. is a B2B archival binding operator serving libraries, museums, and corporate records departments to documented archival standards.

targetAudience.primary: Library conservators, museum registrars, and corporate records managers.
behaviors: Renew on three to five-year terms

dos: Lead with archival standards and certifications
Refer to client institutions by name
donts: No social media at the parent level

Corporate.logoDirection: Wordmark: CASE-BOUND ARCHIVES CO. set in an institutional serif, three lines. A small mark — a stylised closed book silhouette — used on contracts.

typography.primary: Tiempos Headline for the wordmark and headlines
typography.rationale: A reading serif plus a clean grotesk — the institutional archive register.

Creative.tagline: Marbled paper, one sheet at a time.
Creative.brandNameRationale: Anchor: ebru — the Turkish marbled-paper tradition dating to the 15th century, used for endpapers in Ottoman manuscript binding. UNESCO inscribed ebru on its Representative List of Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2014. 'The Ebru Room' frames the brand as a single studio focused on the marbled sheet.
Creative.industrySummary: Creative bookbinding brands play on a single material or process as the editorial frame. Ebru as a brand frame is rich and under-used outside Turkey.
Creative.competitorLandscape: Cockerell Marbled Papers (cockerellmarbledpapers.com) plays the editorial peer. Hatip Hattat (hatiphattat.com) holds the heritage Turkish middle. Jemma Lewis Marbling (jemmalewismarbling.co.uk) is the modern reference. We sit as a single-room ebru studio in the editorial register.
Creative.positioningStatement: The Ebru Room is a creative bookbinding studio built on hand-marbled ebru endpapers — sold as sheets and bound into editions.

targetAudience.primary: Small-press publishers, stationery buyers, and collectors 25-50 who want hand-marbled work.

dos: Print the ebru history on the wrapper

Creative.logoDirection: Wordmark: THE EBRU ROOM set in a warm display serif, three lines centered. Small mark: a single marbled-paper swirl used on sheet wrappers.

typography.primary: GT Sectra for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: Söhne for body and the sheet notes
typography.rationale: A warm display serif plus a clean grotesk — the editorial marbling register.

Creative.scope: The Ebru Room works across the bookbinding & restoration category with a single editorial register.
